description: Repository config for laurigates/.github. The owner-wide Renovate runner supplies everything else; this file adds tracking of two kinds of workflow_call input default: the Claude model IDs (#135) and the plugins-ref commits of laurigates/claude-plugins (#109).

The Claude model lookup needs the runner to pass ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to reusable-renovate.yml, which then authenticates api.anthropic.com; the key must be scoped to one workspace (see the secret's description there). Without it the lookup fails and the pins are not updated; nothing else changes.

customManagers.description: Claude model IDs pinned as workflow_call input defaults, e.g. default: 'claude-opus-5-5'. Dated snapshot IDs and prose mentions are not matched.

The plugins-ref input defaults: the laurigates/claude-plugins commit whose git-plugin script reusable-merge-method.yml and reusable-issue-labels.yml run (#109). git-refs follows the head of main, so every claude-plugins commit is a candidate, not only changes to those scripts.

claude-models.description: GET https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models (active and deprecated models). The per-line regex versioning above drops other model lines and dated snapshot IDs.

packageRules.description: A model change alters review behaviour and cost for every caller, so it gets its own PR instead of riding in a grouped dependency update.

The plugins-ref pins move with every claude-plugins commit, so they get one PR a week of their own. Saturday falls inside the runner's weekend branch-creation window. A bump still needs a read of what the workflow steps parse from the script's output.
